decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line close to the core portfolio and given continued earlier website prominence, it likely has low carrying costs and strategic value in completing tailored system offerings, so the option value of keeping it remains higher than the likely savings from dropping it.

Although it had less visible promotion than A, it is still closely related to the established formwork business and can be retained as a relatively inexpensive option for serving niche customer requirements in an expanding firm.

Its dedicated presentation suggests meaningful commercial intent, and as an adjacent component product it likely supports cross-selling and system completeness, making retention more attractive than withdrawal.

This product appears to have the weakest commitment signal among the survivors, but because it is near the existing offer and probably inexpensive to carry, management would still be more likely to keep it unless clearer evidence of poor demand emerged.
